decisions.reason: It builds directly on our existing modular recycling-plant knowledge and the reported customer saving of more than €600,000 per year is a strong early signal that we can recognise, refine and commercialise its value further.

As a mobile slow-speed shredder close to our established machinery base, it fits our accumulated engineering and service capabilities, and giving it its own page suggests enough strategic and market relevance to continue learning from the launch.

Although early evidence is limited, this modular waste-processing concept is strongly related to what we already know, so our in-house R&D and research cooperation give us good scope to improve and position it rather than exit after only one year.

The mobile trommel screen is adjacent to our core screening and processing competences, and in a growing market a mature German machinery firm with strong after-sales and development capabilities would usually keep such a closely related launch on the market to build experience and sales.
